claims.title: Automatic Notice of Dispute on utility mismatch
claims.statement: When water utility company data does not match my platform data, an automatic Notice of Dispute is issued.

claims.title: Automatic notice when water exceeds potable baseline
claims.statement: When measured water quality exceeds baseline for potable or drinkable water, an automatic notice and rectification workflow is issued.

claims.title: Vulnerability-triggered legal notice workflow
claims.statement: A vulnerability condition triggers timestamped legal notice actions.

priorityAssertion: These three ideas belong to Jamie Wyatt and were conceived and implemented first by Jamie Wyatt.
historicalAssertion: Initial timestamps asserted by claimant as beginning January 2026 and earlier.
intent: Create immutable timestamp evidence on BSV.
